parsed_output.embedding_text: A TikTok slideshow meme by @whoisarrex featuring iconic NBA basketball huddle photos repurposed to describe student life during GCSE and A-Level exams. The content includes the Oklahoma City Thunder (Russell Westbrook, Serge Ibaka) as students gathering exam info from another class; LeBron James and the Cleveland Cavaliers as the smart student teaching peers; Pat Riley, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, and Magic Johnson of the LA Lakers as students who found leaked questions; Derrick Rose and the Chicago Bulls as the friend hyping everyone up; and Kobe Bryant with Team USA (Chris Bosh, Deron Williams) as the group accepting they are 'cooked' before the test. The video uses text overlays and basketball metaphors to capture the humor and stress of school testing culture.
